Name: Joja Worship Center (Altar of Yoba Replacement)
Author: LeelooStardew
Description:
Joja Worship Center replaces the Yoba altar area inside Pierre’s with a Joja-themed worship space! Now the townies can have a space to [b]THRIVE [/b]together. 

The worship center consists of a giant gold Joja Cola statue, a gold cash register, Joja decor, and a weird looking bible (aka fully functional Joja Catalogue).

Also adds 2 new Joja Worship Center cutscenes! 

Config:
[list]
[*]Joja Worship Center appears by default on all saves. [/*]
[*]config.json generates after launching the game once. [/*]
[*]Set JojaMemberRequired to true to require a Joja Membership. [/*]
[*]Can also be changed in Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[/list]Additional mods pictured:
